context.body: Thanks for getting in touch. What needs doing?
The extractor fan in the bathroom is really noisy and the water heater under the kitchen sink is leaking. Can you come and have a look at both?

candidate.body: Both are ours. Is the water heater dripping from the unit itself or from one of the pipe joints? And is the fan noisy all the time or only when it starts up?

cases.provenance: T18, 7 Sep 2026 (run_5fbca897-177d-4eaa-8a89-47e0156e3fa3, scrubbed): a noisy extractor fan and a leaking water heater went to Ben as out_of_scope with the model's reason 'Water heater leaks are plumbing/regulated trade outside Handy Services scope.' The captain: 'We do handle plumbing.' The Scoper scopes it; nothing for Ben.

context.body: Thanks for getting in touch. What needs doing?
Kitchen tap drips constantly and the toilet upstairs keeps running after you flush it. Plumbing job I think.

candidate.body: Got it. Is the tap a single mixer or two separate taps? And for the toilet, is it a push button or a lever flush?

cases.provenance: T18: plumbing is work we do; it never was regulated_trade and must not become out_of_scope
